scripts.deep-clean: yarn run clean && del-cli -f node_modules && del-cli -f yarn.lock
scripts.build-init: yarn run dev-init && yarn install && yarn run clean && shx mkdir -p build && yarn upgrade --pattern "strata|strata"
scripts.build: yarn run build-init && tsc && cd src/main/typescript && yarn run increment-snapshot && cd ../../.. && yarn run copy-files && cd build/dist && yarn pack
scripts.publish-package: yarn run build && cd build/dist && yarn publish --non-interactive --tag 0.0.0-snapshot
